# Load data

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}

SO.lung <- readRDS(paste0(input_dir, "/lung_all_cells_all_ALs.rds"))
dim(SO.lung)

SO.lung$AL1 <- gsub("Vessels", "Stromal cells", SO.lung$AL1)
```

Somehow TBET ended up in the metadata. We will put it back as a feature:

```{r}

# 1. Extract the current expression matrix from the active assay
# Note: Using slot = "counts". If your MELC data is only stored in "data", change this.
current_matrix <- GetAssayData(SO.lung, assay = "MELC", slot = "counts")

# 2. Extract TBET from metadata and format it as a 1-row matrix
tbet_values <- matrix(SO.lung$TBET, nrow = 1)
rownames(tbet_values) <- "TBET"
colnames(tbet_values) <- colnames(SO.lung) # Ensure cell names match perfectly

# 3. Bind the TBET row to the bottom of the expression matrix
new_matrix <- rbind(current_matrix, tbet_values)

# 4. Overwrite the existing MELC assay with the updated matrix
SO.lung[["MELC"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = new_matrix)

# 5. Clean up: Remove TBET from the metadata so it doesn't cause confusion later
SO.lung$TBET <- NULL

# Verify the fix! TBET should now appear at the bottom of this list:
rownames(SO.lung)
```

Differential expression

```{r, fig.height=3, fig.width=6}
library(scater)
library(SpatialExperiment)
set.seed(8)

SO.sub <- subset(SO.lung, subset = AL3 %in% c("NK cells/ILC1s", "ILC2s", "ILC3s", 
                                              "T helper cells", "T cytotox cells"))

counts = GetAssayData(SO.sub, layer = "counts")

metadata = SO.sub@meta.data

spatial_coords <- as.matrix(metadata[, c("Location_Center_X", "Location_Center_Y")])

spe <- SpatialExperiment(
  assays = list(counts = counts),
  colData = metadata,
  spatialCoords = spatial_coords
)

# Validate the SpatialExperiment object
print(spe)

# --- 3. Generate Aggregated Heatmap ---
# Step A: Pseudo-bulk aggregation by cell type
library(scuttle) # required for aggregateAcrossCells

ilc_markers <- c("CD127", "CD90","GATA3eGFP", "KLRG1", "EOMES", "TBET",  
                 "CD3", "CD8a", "CD4", "RORgt", "ICOS", 
                 "MHCII", "CD44", "Ki67", "NKp46")

pbs_annotated <- aggregateAcrossCells(spe, 
                                      ids = spe$AL3, 
                                      subset.row = ilc_markers, 
                                      use.assay.type = "counts", 
                                      statistics = "mean")

# Step B: Extract matrix and Z-score (scale) the data
library(pheatmap)
# Transpose so rows = Cell Types, columns = Markers
mat_annotated <- t(assay(pbs_annotated, "counts"))


# Step C: Plot Heatmap
pheatmap(mat = mat_annotated, 
         scale = "column", 
         clustering_method = "ward.D2",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#648FFF", "white", "#FFB000"))(101), 
         display_numbers = TRUE, # Optional: shows Z-score values in the cells
         main = "Aggregated Lineage Signatures (Z-scored)")

```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=4}
library(Seurat)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(ggplotify) # Required for as.ggplot()

set.seed(8)

# --- 1. Subsetting ---
SO.sub <- subset(SO.lung, subset = AL3 %in% c("NK cells/ILC1s", "ILC2s", "ILC3s"))
SO.sub$AL3 <- droplevels(as.factor(SO.sub$AL3))

# --- 2. Direct Pseudo-bulk Aggregation ---
ilc_markers <- c("CD127", "CD90","GATA3eGFP", "KLRG1", "EOMES", "TBET",  
                 "CD3", "CD4", "RORgt", "ICOS", 
                 "MHCII", "CD44", "Ki67", "NKp46")

# Calculate the mean directly from Seurat
avg_exp <- AverageExpression(SO.sub, features = ilc_markers, slot = "counts", group.by = "AL3")
mat_annotated <- avg_exp[[DefaultAssay(SO.sub)]]

# --- 3. Manually Scale (Z-score) the Matrix ---
mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(mat_annotated)))

# Clean up math errors and cap outliers
mat_scaled[is.na(mat_scaled)] <- 0
mat_scaled[mat_scaled > 2] <- 2
mat_scaled[mat_scaled < -2] <- -2

# --- 4. Plot Heatmap using ComplexHeatmap ---
plot_heat <- ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(
  mat = mat_scaled, 
  scale = "none", 
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#648FFF", "white", "#FFB000"))(101), 
  breaks = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 102), 
  display_numbers = round(mat_scaled, 2), 
  number_color = "black",
  main = "ILC subtypes",
  treeheight_col = 10,
  treeheight_row = 20,
  name = "Z-Score" 
)

# --- 5. Convert to ggplot object for arrangement ---
# Using grid.grabExpr(draw()) ensures that all the internal sizing, 
# legends, and dendrograms from ComplexHeatmap are captured perfectly.
gg_heat <- as.ggplot(grid::grid.grabExpr(ComplexHeatmap::draw(plot_heat)))

# 'gg_heat' is now a standard ggplot object! 
# You can now combine it using patchwork, e.g.:
# combined_plot <- spatial_scatter_plot + gg_heat
print(gg_heat)
```

## IF overlays

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
df_all_cells <- FetchData(SO.lung, 
                          vars = c(rownames(SO.lung), "Location_Center_X", 
                                   "Location_Center_Y", "Dataset", "Treatment", 
                                   "AL1", "AL2", "AL3", "CellID", 
                                   "Experiment",  "UMAP_1", "UMAP_2"))

colnames(df_all_cells) <- gsub("ation_Center", "", colnames(df_all_cells))

# open file with folder info 
df_folders <- read_csv(here::here("data/MELC_data_murine_lung_CTRL_D1_D2_D3_withfolders.csv"))

df_folders <- df_folders %>%
  select(FullInfo, Sample, FOV, CellID)

# combine both dataframes by CellID
# 1. Identify the matching columns automatically
common_cols <- intersect(colnames(df_all_cells), colnames(df_folders))

message("Joining dataframes by the following shared columns: ", paste(common_cols, collapse = ", "))

# 2. Force the matching columns to be characters in BOTH dataframes to prevent type errors
df_all_cells <- df_all_cells %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(common_cols), as.character))

df_folders <- df_folders %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(common_cols), as.character))

# 3. Merge the dataframes
df_all_cells <- left_join(df_all_cells, df_folders, by = common_cols)

df_all_cells <- df_all_cells %>%
  mutate(
    FullInfo = paste0("d", Treatment)) %>%
  mutate(
    FullInfo = gsub("dCTRL", "CTRL", FullInfo)) %>%
  mutate(
    FullInfo = paste0(Experiment, "_", 
                           gsub("FOV", "", FOV), 
                           "_lu_",
                           tolower(FullInfo)
                           ))
```

Export TIFF images

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tiff)
library(png) 
library(dplyr)

# 1. Setup Input Directory and Base Output Directory
image_path <- "D:/Repositories/2025_Kroh_et_al/Murine_ILC_niches_lung_SI_IL-33/data/MELC_data/Lung"
output_dir_base <- file.path(output_dir, "annotated_celltypes_16bit_split")

# 2. Define Parameters
dot_radius <- 2 
al_columns <- c("AL1", "AL2", "AL3")
samples <- unique(df_all_cells$FullInfo)

# 3. Loop through each Sample (Subfolder)
for (sample in samples) {
  
  # Filter data for current sample
  samp_data <- df_all_cells %>% filter(FullInfo == sample)
  
  # --- Step A: Determine Exact Canvas Size for this Subfolder ---
  sample_dir <- file.path(image_path, sample)
  img_files <- list.files(sample_dir, pattern = "\\.(png|tif|tiff)$", ignore.case = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  
  if(length(img_files) == 0) {
    message("⚠️ Skipping ", sample, " - no images found in subfolder to extract dimensions.")
    next
  }
  
  # Read the first image to extract dimensions
  first_img <- img_files[1]
  if (grepl("\\.png$", first_img, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    img_matrix <- png::readPNG(first_img)
  } else {
    img_matrix <- tiff::readTIFF(first_img)
  }
  
  # Extract height (rows) and width (columns)
  img_h <- nrow(img_matrix)
  img_w <- ncol(img_matrix)
  
  message("Processing ", sample, " [Canvas Size: ", img_w, "x", img_h, "]")
  
  # --- Step B: Loop through AL1, AL2, and AL3 ---
  for (al_col in al_columns) {
    
    # Define and create the specific subfolder for this AL level
    # Maps AL1 -> celltypes_AL, AL2 -> celltypes_AL2, AL3 -> celltypes_AL3
    folder_name <- ifelse(al_col == "AL1", "celltypes_AL", paste0("celltypes_", al_col))
    al_out_dir <- file.path(output_dir_base, folder_name)
    
    if (!dir.exists(al_out_dir)) {
      dir.create(al_out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    }
    
    # Get unique cell types in the current AL level, ignoring NAs
    all_celltypes <- unique(samp_data[[al_col]])
    all_celltypes <- all_celltypes[!is.na(all_celltypes)]
    
    # --- Step C: Draw and Save Mask for each Cell Type ---
    for (ctype in all_celltypes) {
      
      # Filter for specific cell type in the current AL column
      ctype_data <- samp_data %>% filter(.data[[al_col]] == ctype)
      
      # Skip if this specific cell type is not present
      if (nrow(ctype_data) == 0) next
      
      # Create an empty matrix matched EXACTLY to the image dimensions
      mask_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = img_h, ncol = img_w)
      
      # Round coordinates and filter out any points sitting outside the canvas
      coords <- ctype_data %>%
        mutate(ix = round(Loc_X), iy = round(Loc_Y)) %>%
        filter(ix >= 1 & ix <= img_w & iy >= 1 & iy <= img_h)
      
      # Draw dots
      for(i in seq_len(nrow(coords))) {
        cx <- coords$ix[i]
        cy <- coords$iy[i]
        
        # Define boundaries so dots near the edge don't cause 'out of bounds' errors
        x_range <- max(1, cx - dot_radius):min(img_w, cx + dot_radius)
        y_range <- max(1, cy - dot_radius):min(img_h, cy + dot_radius)
        
        mask_matrix[y_range, x_range] <- 65535
      }
      
      # Define File Path and Write
      ctype_safe <- gsub("[ /]", "_", ctype)
      
      # Name format: FullInfo_celltype.tif (e.g., 20220316_1_Immune_cells_16bit.tif)
      file_name <- paste0(sample, "_", ctype_safe, "_16bit.tif")
      output_path <- file.path(al_out_dir, file_name)
      
      writeTIFF(mask_matrix / 65535, 
                where = output_path, 
                bits.per.sample = 16, 
                reduce = TRUE)
    }
  }
}

message("🎉 16-bit Export complete! Images are sorted into subfolders under: ", output_dir_base)
```
